candidates.predictive_shield: curved-only static cap plus 2-step force/delta prediction; starts reducing at 9 N, zero force action at 11 N, minimum -0.50

flat_contract: all candidates are exact action passthrough on flat

stage2.entry: candidate has fewer cylinder+freeform force overloads than control, zero sensor faults, and no new flat safety failure
stage2.arms: control plus the best entered candidate

final_gate: candidate cylinder+freeform safety pass count must exceed paired control
candidate must have zero force overloads across both directions
flat safety and quality pass counts must not regress
mean curved final all4 area drop versus control must be <= 1 percentage point
sensor fault steps must be zero
stop_rules: do not tune thresholds after seeing results
do not run PPO or reward retraining in F8
do not modify or promote champion/release artifacts
reward_candidate_disposition: deferred: existing environment already has overshoot and instability penalties; validate a deterministic safety layer before authorizing delayed-reward PPO
supervision_candidate_disposition: F7 richer geometry supervision failed its frozen offline entry criterion
